query:
SELECT e.inep, e.nome, e.qtdAp AS ap_planejado, e.apAdicional,
       os.id AS os_id, os.qtdApInstalado, os.status, os.dataConclusao, os.observacao
FROM escolas e
LEFT JOIN ordens_servico os ON os.escolaId = e.id
WHERE e.inep = '29153670';
